exposure: Mode of previous cesarean delivery (during labor or not)
Internal cervical os open or closed
outcome: Time from DBC insertion to delivery
cohort: 105 women with previous cesarean delivery, singleton term fetus, cephalic presentation, and unfavorable cervix (Bishop score <6) at a French tertiary care hospital
finding: Initial Bishop score of at least three, previous cesarean delivery during labor, and an open internal cervical os were significant predictors of successful cervical ripening using DBC.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery during labor was a significant predictor of successful cervical ripening (aOR 4.38, 95% CI 1.10-17.45).
